background: ICBC (London) plc is the UK-incorporated subsidiary of Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, the world's largest bank by assets and majority-owned by the Chinese state, serving Chinese corporates and trade and treasury business in London.
synthesis: None of Fitch, S&P or Moody's publishes a rating on the London subsidiary, and the site holds no capital or liquidity figures for it, so there is no peer comparison to make. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days. Any comfort comes from the state-owned parent rather than from anything published about the entity itself, so this is a parental-support name: the question for a depositor is how far ICBC would stand behind its London subsidiary, and nothing shown here answers it.
